modules.module_title: Introduction to Prasuti and Stree Roga

pcs.pc_description: Orient about Prasooti Tantra, Stree Roga department, and the Ayush healthcare system.
Identify the Integration of AYUSH with modern healthcare
Role of Tridosha (Vata, Pitta, Kapha) in female reproductive health
Identify Panchamahabhuta and their influence on the human body.
Explain the philosophical and theoretical foundations of AYUSH systems
Coordinate effectively with patients and healthcare professionals.
Explain the Rachna and kriya of the female reproductive system
Orient about the hormonal regulation of the menstrual cycle, ovulation, fertilization, and pregnancy.
Identify the stages of Prasava(labour) and the postpartum period.
Aware of Stree Roga Tantra and its application in clinical practice.
Assist in Ayurvedic management of menstrual disorders, infertility, and other gynecologic problems.
Promote Ayurvedic principles of Garbhini Paricharya(prenatal care).
Guide according to Ayurvedic principles of sutika (postnatal care).
Coordinate for Garbhini Paricharya: Prenatal care, including dietary guidelines, lifestyle modifications, and herbal therapies.
Coordinate for Sutika Paricharya: Postnatal care, including dietary recommendations, lifestyle modifications, and herbal therapies to promote healing and lactation
Orient about Shishu Roga: Pediatric care, including infant health and development.
Orient about the national program on women and child health
